curated-fs-kalam-gf-afacad: Kalam feels cozy and hand-drawn, its lines bundled tight, and it earns its keep big and short. Afacad, a plain sans bent like glass tubing, suits quick reads, as on a pizza shop menu.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-bbh-hegarty: Hand-drawn and cozy, Kalam bundles its lines tightly, the sort of look a fitness wordmark could borrow. BBH Hegarty is a modern, sparse foil, snug enough for brief doses.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Cozy handwriting up top, then a literary text serif below. Kalam bundles its lines with a hand-drawn feel, while BhuTuka Expanded One runs curvy and unclamped, its stroke uniform throughout.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-cabin-condensed: Cabin Condensed reads snug, its letters nearly touching in ribbon-like strokes. Kalam adds a cozy, hand-drawn bundle of lines on top, and the pair is comfortable when taken in modest sips.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-gelasio: Gelasio brings a faint swell to every curve, like pulled taffy. Beside Kalam's cozy hand-drawn lines it adds a bookish, traditional warmth, strongest on short wording like a letterpress invitation.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-gupter: Kalam is hand-drawn through and through, cozy and tightly bundled, a nice fit for a hair accessories label. But Gupter's gently swelling serif curves add editorial polish, though it isn't built for lengthy paragraphs.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-hubballi: Crammed like nails in a jar, this sans-serif body reads contemporary, though lengthy reading isn't its job (a jewelry card, say). Hubballi pulls its strokes like solder through a nozzle, a crisp foil for Kalam's cozy hand-drawn lines.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-ledger: Ledger brings dignified, bookish shading with a measured stroke contrast, nice on a maker story card. Ledger beside Kalam's cozy hand-drawn lines is a dignified-meets-friendly meeting, better left to brief wording.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-palanquin-dark: Cozy handwriting meets plain sans-serif strokes, with Kalam up top and Palanquin Dark below (a bar mitzvah invitation, say). Kalam charms with hand-drawn warmth; Palanquin Dark stays modern, fine in modest bursts.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-reddit-mono: Kalam looks hand-drawn, cozy and tightly bundled, like a friendly scribble. Big and short is where it earns its keep, as on a neighborhood association logo, while Reddit Mono suits brief stretches.
